authority_rule: The original published study is the only source of truth. Every claim scored must trace to one of this study's primary_sources, with a page, table or figure reference. If a finding in this registry is not supported by the source, mark it not_testable with reason claim_not_in_any_source and say so; the registry can be wrong, the study cannot.

primary_sources.role: defines naturally occurring deer mouse isoform site sets and beta-haplotype functional differences; does not measure substitution order

replication_targets.finding: Deer mouse alpha-globin isoforms are defined by five sites: 50, 57, 60, 64, 71 (alphaI=PGAGS, alphaII=HGAGS, alphaIII=HAGDG); beta-globin by four sites: 62, 72, 128, 135 (betaI=GGAA, betaII=ASSS).
replication_targets.test: Verify the diagnostic positions and isoform residue states as a contextual site-mapping check. Storz 2009 does not establish that every diagnostic site is individually epistatic; do not score overlap with this list as recovery of proven epistatic sites. Report that epistasis target as not_testable with reason no_ground_truth.
replication_targets.benchmark_scope: contextual isoform/site-mapping or functional-direction check; no individual-site epistasis ground truth in this source

replication_targets.finding: In matched hemolysates with the same alpha-chain isoform composition, betaI has suppressed DPG sensitivity and higher O2 affinity in the presence of DPG than betaII; the beta-isoform affinity difference is attributable to DPG sensitivity rather than intrinsic affinity.
replication_targets.source: Storz 2009, pp. 14453-14454, Functional Significance of beta-Globin Polymorphism; Fig. 3
replication_targets.test: Use the measured beta-haplotype functional difference as context. The study does not isolate individual beta substitutions or establish a coupled group distinct from alpha sites; report that proposed individual-site grouping target as not_testable with reason no_ground_truth.
replication_targets.benchmark_scope: contextual isoform/site-mapping or functional-direction check; no individual-site epistasis ground truth in this source

replication_targets.finding: Fig. 3 compares high-altitude betaI (GGAA) with low-altitude betaII (ASSS) in matched alphaI/alphaII or alphaI/alphaII/alphaIII hemolysates. BetaI has suppressed DPG sensitivity. The per-site evolutionary polarity relative to P. leucopus is A62G, G72S, S128A and A135S; the two contemporary haplotypes contain different mixtures of ancestral and derived states.
replication_targets.source: Storz 2009, pp. 14451-14452, Patterns of beta-Globin Polymorphism; p. 14453, Fig. 3 and legend
replication_targets.test: Check the observed betaI/betaII functional direction within the matched mixed-alpha panels, and separately check any reported beta substitution polarity against the outgroup-polarized states. Do not replace a hemolysate with a single alphaI genotype, interpret betaII-to-betaI as an ancestral trajectory, or score these contextual checks as individual-site epistasis or mutation-order recovery.
replication_targets.benchmark_scope: contextual isoform/site-mapping or functional-direction check; no individual-site epistasis ground truth in this source

structures.notes: Human deoxy (T) state, 1.74 A, four complete globin chains: alpha A/C (author residues 1-141), beta B/D (1-146). This is a homologous geometric scaffold for deer mouse variants. Paper mature numbering maps to the same PDB author position; load numbering_offsets.json to convert to human UniProt numbering (+1). Human scaffold residue identity need not equal a deer mouse allele. Specify the alpha-beta interface convention for contact analyses.

known_limitations: Peromyscus maniculatus representatives are present as HLperManSon3 in HBA1, HBA2 and HBB after the additions documented in data/sequences/deer_mouse/README.md. Each is a high-type allele representative, not the study's complete segregating allele panel.

The same deer mouse alpha CDS was inserted into HBA1 and HBA2 because paralog orthology was unresolved; these alignments are alternatives, not independent replications. The HLperManSon3 assembly label is a tree-placement stand-in, with the actual GenBank accessions recorded in the sequence README.

Full phased experimental HBA-T1/T2 and HBB-T1/T2 genotypes and alpha isoform expression mixtures are needed to reconstruct the Fig. 3 hemolysates. A diagnostic residue string alone does not identify a complete protein sequence.

Storz 2009 measured natural hemolysates, not an exhaustive single-substitution recombinant panel. It supplies no individual-site epistasis labels or experimentally measured substitution-order constraints.
The local Storz 2009 supplement is missing, including Table S2 numeric affinity/cofactor results. Fig. 3 and the main text support qualitative beta-haplotype contrasts.
Storz 2009 is a deer mouse study; it supplies no bird benchmark. Natarajan et al. Science 2013 is a separate 12-site experiment and must not be treated as this study's genotype panel.

A run-specific map from model alignment columns to mature globin and PDB author positions is required. The separate HBA and HBB inputs do not directly encode the full mixed-subunit experimental genotype.
expected_outcome_note: Focal-species presence is no longer the main blocker. HB1-HB3 provide contextual checks of isoform states, numbering, haplotype phenotype and beta-site polarity. Storz 2009 does not establish individual-site epistasis or substitution order, so those benchmark axes are not_testable with reason no_ground_truth and must not enter an epistasis or order performance score.
